user.title: Hikvision NVR
user.description: Use a dedicated NVR user with the Remote: Parameters Settings permission. The port is 80 for HTTP and usually 443 for HTTPS.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off to trust a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate. Only applies with HTTPS.

review.title: Events to arm/disarm

triggers.title: Choose events
triggers.description: Events listed here notify Hik-Connect when armed. Pick the events you use (preselected: those armed right now; the list is empty if the NVR is disarmed). Selecting an event whose detection is off on the camera has no effect.

reconfigure.title: Hikvision NVR connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address, HTTPS settings or credentials of this NVR.

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off to trust a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate. Only applies with HTTPS.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to the NVR again
reauth_confirm.description: The NVR rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current ones.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password (the username is case-sensitive)
error.ssl_error: TLS/certificate error. Check the port, or turn off "Verify SSL certificate" to trust an untrusted certificate

abort.wrong_device: This is a different NVR than the one originally configured
